ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across approximately 90% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels accounting for roughly 10%, concentrated at the distal tips and as scattered speckles.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark contiguous region across central and proximal fluke surfaces. Distinct high-contrast white mottling and solid banding at the far left and far right distal tips. Scattered white punctate spots (speckling) distributed across the ventral surface of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped median notch at the center of the trailing edge with an estimated angular opening of 130 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated profile. The right lobe trailing edge contains approximately 6-8 distinct peaks and valleys of moderate amplitude. The left lobe exhibits smaller, more frequent micro-serrations along its boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes follow a convex sweep trajectory from the median notch to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Large, dense cluster of circular high-contrast pixel groups (barnacles) at the extreme left tip. A smaller, secondary cluster of similar circular features is located on the extreme right tip. Punctate white circular spots are scattered across the lower right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, nearly vertical white linear mark on the inner left lobe. Multiple thin, diagonal parallel white linear marks (rake marks) are visible on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both distal tips, appearing as irregular, high-relief light-colored masses. Visible white rake marks and linear scarring on both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique, prominent vertical white slash-like mark on the inner region of the left lobe.
